abbreviation._instruction: Enter the official abbreviation of this anatomical atlas.

digitalIdentifier._instruction: Add the globally unique and persistent digital identifier of this research product. Note that this digital identifier will be used to reference all attached research product versions.

hasTerminology._instruction: Enter the parcellation terminology of this anatomical atlas.

ontologyIdentifier._instruction: Enter the internationalized resource identifier (IRI) to the related ontological term matching this anatomical atlas.

usedTaxon._instruction: Add the taxon (e.g., species) that was used for the creation of this anatomical atlas.
